video_title: Olivia Miles On Learning From Her Lynx Vets & Inspiring Young Fans With Her Goggles

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the leadership and impact of Minnesota Lynx veterans
quotes.excerpt: She has a very maternal approach to our team and even though she was hurt

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Who has made the game easiest for you in your rookie season?

text_blocks.speaker: Olivia Miles
text_blocks.text: Nafisa, she is just the epitome of a great basketball player and a great leader. Obviously she is a mom, so she knows what she is doing. She has a very maternal approach to our team and even though she was hurt for a majority of the season, she was still so engaged. Courtney has been great. She brings a different fun, swaggy energy to the team. She is a great vet off the court as well. They let me be me, and that is the most that I could ask for.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the importance of veteran mentorship for young players
quotes.excerpt: They held us accountable. They made sure that we understood how to go about being professionals.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: I want you to speak to what she was talking about with her vets and how that helped you out when you came to our team with the vets.

text_blocks.speaker: Olivia Miles
text_blocks.text: It was day two when Oak put his arm around me and was like, I am going to help you with this league. I never felt like I didn't know, and I was one of the players that was willing to ask questions. We had four young guys and the rest of our locker room was veterans of eight years or more. I never felt like I wasn't prepared or didn't know. They held us accountable. They made sure that we understood how to go about being professionals. That was a key element to helping us become who we are because that took away a lot of things that some rookies or young guys are still fighting with.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on learning from Cheryl Reeve's championship experience
quotes.excerpt: She has run the one during the dynasty years, so she knows what it takes to win.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: How has she helped you this season in your rookie year?

text_blocks.speaker: Olivia Miles
text_blocks.text: What is most helpful is that she has been with Cheryl for so long, so I can get a different perspective from Cheryl. She has run the one during the dynasty years, so she knows what it takes to win and she knows what Cheryl is expecting. That has been really helpful just picking her brain. She is a great person, she is herself unapologetically, and I just admire that so much. She has really helped me to just be loose and play and have fun and allowed me to make mistakes. She is the one that I really watch film with a lot. She picks everything apart, like here is what works, here is this, and here is the pass I threw to Maya. It is crazy because she got to play with all those girls and she has such success with them.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on embracing her brand and wearing goggles
quotes.excerpt: It is a symbol of me just not caring. It has become a part of my brand.
quotes.quote: It is so cool like little kids especially, people are DMing me saying like I started wearing glasses because of you. It is a slippery slope because I got bullied or made fun of for wearing them and kids get made fun of for wearing glasses. But it is a symbol of me just not caring. Everyone is always like, why don't you wear contacts? I am like, because I don't want to. It has become a part of my brand. Why change just because you want me to change? I hope that I can be that inspiration to kids who may get made fun of for wearing them. I know I am being me, don't say you hope, you are.
